description: Deterministic strategy used after filtering a CreativeRepresentationSet against one seller destination contract. `representation_order` selects the first compatible representation in source array order. `highest_compatible_vast` is valid only when the destination format_kind is `video_vast` or `audio_vast`; it selects the compatible VAST representation with the highest exact VAST version, and equal-version ties are resolved by source array order. Using it for another format is INVALID_REQUEST and never falls back silently.
title: Representation Selection Strategy
